candidates.change_summary: Remove the if(intitalized)revert(); guard so that MinSum can be changed after initialization, resulting in a different MinSum value after a subsequent SetMinSum call.
Remove the require(!locked_) check from the modifier, allowing reentrant calls that bypass the lock and potentially alter MinSum during an active call.
Remove the `locked_ = true;` statement so the modifier never blocks reentrant calls, enabling reentrant modification of MinSum.
Remove the `locked_ = false;` cleanup so that the lock stays true permanently after the first call, preventing any further calls to SetMinSum (changing MinSum from its first-set value).
Delete the if(intitalized)revert(); statement so that SetMinSum can be called multiple times, changing MinSum after initialization.
Replace MinSum = _val; with MinSum = _val + 1; so the stored value always differs from the argument.
Delete the require(!locked_); guard from the modifier, allowing reentrant calls which could bypass the intitalized check via reentrancy.
Delete locked_ = true; from the modifier, breaking the reentrancy lock and potentially allowing reentrant calls to bypass the intitalized check.
Delete locked_ = false; from the modifier, causing the lock to remain true permanently, which would block all future nonReentrant_ calls including SetMinSum after the first call.
Replace if(intitalized)revert(); with require(false); so SetMinSum always reverts, making MinSum never settable.
